❌ Disappointed with the Venue Management ❌
I booked this venue for my sister's wedding, and I’m very disappointed with the service. Snacks were served at 9 PM and dinner started only at 10:30 PM — way too late for such an important occasion. Guests were waiting, and it created a very uncomfortable situation for us. The overall coordination and time management were very poor.
Not recommended if you’re expecting professional service for your big day.
